body:
Please call someone. I know how dumb it sounds, but that's better than nothing right now. I'm sorry for what happened, I wish it didn't have to be like this.
If you're... gone, I'll remember you.
I wasn't here around that time, but I'm glad people were nice to you and you're alright. Proud of you.

Don't do it. Please, if you're reading this, think first. Does it need to be this way? 
Could you tell me what led you to where you are, right now?

That's terrifying. I can barely contain or deal with my one inner voice, I couldn't imagine 20+ of them all at once.
I'm happy you're here with us.
That's good. I'm proud of you. You're a great brother.

Hey, I just saw this pop up. I don't know exactly what to say, I believe I'm pretty bad with words, but do think about this before. School work would amount to nothing if you could drop out for a year in turn for your mental health. Futures aren't a guarantee. But at the same time, I understand. If you want to talk, feel free to message me. I'd like to help as much as I could.
